{{Infobox/Item |image = Plasmaflux Power Orb.png |type = [[Support Items]] |rarity = Legendary |id = PLASMAFLUX_POWER_ORB |slayer_level_requirement = Wolf Slayer 8 |upgrades_from = Overflux Power Orb |raw_materials = * 1187840 Gold Ingot * 614400 Redstone * 102400 Lapis Lazuli * 40960 Obsidian * 29712 Wolf Tooth * 1280 Emerald * 1 Overflux Capacitor * 1 Plasma Nucleus |mat_cost_bazaar = * 16 Wolf Tooth * 8 Enchanted Emerald * 4 Enchanted Lapis Lazuli Block * 160 Golden Tooth * 24 Enchanted Redstone Block |auctionable=yes |reforgeable=no |enchantable=no |museum = yes |museum_xp = 15 |museum_category = combat |bazaar_not_including = [[Overflux Capacitor]], [[Plasma Nucleus]] |bazaar_not_including_upgr = [[Plasma Nucleus]] |raw_materials_upgr=* 368640 Gold Ingot * 40960 Obsidian * 9216 Wolf Tooth * 1 Plasma Nucleus |mat_cost_bazaar_upgr=* 368640 Gold Ingot * 40960 Obsidian * 9216 Wolf Tooth }} The '''Plasmaflux Power Orb''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Power Orbs|Power Orb]] usable after the player reaches {{Coll|Wolf Slayer 8}}. It is an upgraded form of the {{Item|Overflux Power Orb}}, and is the final upgrade in the Orb series. Its requirement, the {{Item|Plasma Nucleus}}, can be purchased from the [[Dark Auction]] during the [[Dark Auction#Darker Auctions|Darker Auction]] Event when {{NPCSprite|Scorpius}} is elected as mayor. __TOC__ == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Wolf Slayer LVL 8}} |A1 = Enchanted Obsidian, 64 |B1 = Plasma Nucleus |C1 = Enchanted Obsidian, 64 |A2 = Golden Tooth, 24 |B2 = Overflux Power Orb |C2 = Golden Tooth, 24 |A3 = Enchanted Obsidian, 64 |B3 = Golden Tooth, 24 |C3 = Enchanted Obsidian, 64 |Output = Plasmaflux Power Orb }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |rarity = legendary |type = Deployable |item_ability_name = Deploy |item_ability_activation = Right Click |item_ability_description = Place an orb for {{Green|60s}} buffing up to {{Cyan|5}} players within {{Green|18}} blocks.

{{DG|Vitality Cost:}} {{Stat|vitality|50|icononly=yes}}

{{Gold|Orb Buff: Plasmaflux}}
Heal yourself for {{hp|60}} per second.
Heal others for {{hp|30}} per second.
Gain {{Stat|health regen|+125}}.
Grants {{aqua|+125%}} base mana regen.
Grants {{stat|str|+35}}.
{{Dark Gray|Only one deployable buff applies.}} |item_ability_stats = Health, Health Regen, Strength }} Using its ability does not remove or use up the item. When placed, it cannot be picked up; the ability spawns a new orb. == Trivia == * Only 1 [[Deployables|Deployable]] can be placed at the same time (meaning a [[Plasmaflux Power Orb]] cannot be placed alongside an [[SOS Flare]]). * Despite the crafting recipe being moved to {{Coll|Wolf Slayer 8}}, it can still be used at {{Coll|Wolf Slayer 7}}. This may be an oversight. * It requires less {{Item|Golden Tooth|text=Golden Teeth}} than its predecessor. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/June 10|Removed the {{Stat|Vitality|+7.5}}, {{Stat|Mending|+7.5}}, and {{Stat|Health|3%}} per second healing from the {{Gold|Plasmaflux}} buff.|Changed the {{Gold|Plasmaflux}} buff to heal the spawning player {{Stat|Health|60}} per second, other players {{Stat|Health|30}} per second, and granting {{Stat|Health Regen|+125}} to both groups of players.|Added a {{Stat|Vitality}} cost of {{Dark Red|50}} to the ability.}} |beta= {{History|0.9.8|[[File:Plasmaflux Power Orb.png|26px]] Added '''Plasmaflux Power Orb'''.}} {{history|0.19.3|The '''Plasmaflux Power Orb'''{{'}}s crafting recipe is now unlocked at {{Coll|Wolf Slayer 8}} instead of {{Coll|Wolf Slayer 7}}.}} {{History|0.26.1|Removed the {{Stat|Vitality|+7.5}}, {{Stat|Mending|+7.5}}, and {{Stat|Health|3%}} per second healing from the {{Gold|Plasmaflux}} buff.|Changed the {{Gold|Plasmaflux}} buff to heal the spawning player {{Stat|Health|60}} per second, other players {{Stat|Health|30}} per second, and granting {{Stat|Health Regen|+125}} to both groups of players.|Added a {{Stat|Vitality}} cost of {{Dark Red|50}} to the ability.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Slayer/Wolf}} [[Category:Power Orbs]] [[Category:Support Items]]
